content.text: {"summary":"Starting at 12:30 UTC the io-shop error rate jumped from ~1-2% baseline to 18-40%, with a new error signature (ZeroDivisionError: division by zero) replacing the pre-existing low-level UpstreamTimeout noise. The jump coincides exactly with two feature flags being flipped - monthly-spend-feature going off->on and legacy-checkout-fallback going on->off - with no deploys or other config changes recorded for the service in the surrounding 24 hours; the new-code path enabled by monthly-spend-feature is the most likely source of the division-by-zero.","cause_type":"feature-flag-toggle","confidence":0.6,"supporting_evidence":["2026-08-30T12:30:00Z INFO io-shop: monthly-spend-feature=off 90 / on 110 - 200 evaluations","2026-08-30T12:31:00Z INFO io-shop: monthly-spend-feature=on - 200 evaluations","2026-08-30T12:30:00Z ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero","2026-08-30T12:31:00Z WARN io-shop: account page error rate at 40% over the last minute","{\"bucket_id\": \"2026-08-30T12:29:00Z\", \"error_rate\": 0.005, ...}","{\"bucket_id\": \"2026-08-30T12:30:00Z\", \"error_rate\": 0.18, ...}","{\"bucket_id\": \"2026-08-30T12:31:00Z\", \"error_rate\": 0.4, ...}","(no changes were recorded for this service in that window)"],"subject":"monthly-spend-feature","alternatives":[{"summary":"The same error spike may instead have been caused by legacy-checkout-fallback being turned off at 12:30, which would route account-page requests off the legacy fallback path and onto code that raises ZeroDivisionError.","cause_type":"feature-flag-toggle","confidence":0.35,"supporting_evidence":["2026-08-30T12:30:00Z INFO io-shop: legacy-checkout-fallback=off 107 / on 93 - 200 evaluations","2026-08-30T12:31:00Z INFO io-shop: legacy-checkout-fallback=off - 200 evaluations","2026-08-30T12:30:00Z ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero","2026-08-30T12:34:00Z WARN io-shop: account page error rate at 36% over the last minute"],"subject":"legacy-checkout-fallback"}]}
